summary: Three churches in Olean and Allegany. The newest bulletin prints no Mass-time box, so the weekly Masses come from the dated Mass intentions repeated across five weekly issues, plus the Sacraments box and the Week at a Glance for Confession and Adoration. Open: the November 1 family Holy Hour.

slots.rationale: R30: a Holy Hour is Adoration under POLICY, at the Basilica, with a definite start. It is aimed at faith-formation families ('all grades, siblings and parents') but nothing says others may not come, so I lean toward including it. The 4:00-6:00 PM span covers the potluck too, so no end time is given (POLICY, Final source checks). Only a dated entry is offered: the Oct 4 'Morning Star Family Holy Hour' (4:00 PM, BSMA) was also on a first Sunday, but no bulletin calls it monthly (R33).
